description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for Git reference transaction hooks, verifying behaviors like updating refs, handling aborts, capturing updates, and symbolic ref operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success based on provided commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or output streams, failing the test if they differ.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in command output or files during tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test success or failure cleanup.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites necessary for the test, e.g., features or environment.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: A helper to call specific Git hooks in test scenarios.
